svg.title: Banneret — spheres inside the party wheel
svg.desc: Proposed wheel layout with four skill sectors per hero and follower sections between them. Expanded Strike example: skill levels open tiers, sphere purchases buy passive nodes, a Light identity gate reveals Holy Strike, and an unbought Rupture node in tier one remains available. Only the next identity gate is shown beyond currently revealed tiers.
svg.text: LAYOUT PROPOSAL · Illustrative nodes and identities; no costs or balance values specified.
Four skill sectors per hero · followers between heroes
Outward rings still show skill tiers.
4–6 passive nodes per tier · illustrative density, not final content.
Skill level has opened tier 2. A Light sphere chose its identity.
Six illustrative passives. Purchases are permanent; unbought nodes remain.
Level unlocked this tier; the Light gate determined its available passives.
More room for skill-specific choices, without revealing future branches.
Take a skill upgrade before progressing. Future branches stay hidden.
Gate choices are permanent. No respec or sphere shop in this proposal.
Passive count, effects and sphere costs are illustrative; gate cost handling is open.
One skill tree · earlier tiers remain useful
